title: sideroxylon portoricense subsp. minutiflorum
intro: Sideroxylon portoricense subsp. minutiflorum, commonly known as the Cuban Bulletwood or Guanacaste, is a plant species in the family Sapotaceae. The health benefits of Sideroxylon portoricense subsp. minutiflorum include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Its therapeutic actions include exhibiting antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory activities, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Sideroxylon portoricense subsp. minutiflorum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
